snippet.title: Beneath their Names // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4086490/Beneath_their_Names/

You are a scholarship student at the secluded Veir Academy. Two heroines. Nora or Lika? Trust or distance? Submit to the system — or break it? An introspective visual novel about tension, closeness, and silent choices.

Developed by
Owl's Howls aka @OwlsHowlsOfficial 

Notice: Beneath their Names is no longer available on the Steam store.
